title: HCV reference-residue analysis: data and code
description: Data and code reproducing every number and data panel in 'Hepatitis C virus resistance a decade after direct-acting antivirals: when the resistance residue is the wild type'. Reference amino acids at fourteen resistance-associated NS5A and NS5B positions across all 93 confirmed HCV genotype and subtype reference genomes, scored against EASL 2020 Table 7.
